result.summary: No critical or major visual breakage is apparent. Excluding the intentionally clipped horizontal carousel items and bottom-viewport cutoff, only minor content/accessibility concerns remain.

issues.description: A promo badge on the lower pizza card shows "-100%", which reads ambiguously and could imply a nonsensical negative discount rather than a clear offer.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the label, e.g. use "100% off", "Free delivery", or a specific discount amount, and validate promo badge text before rendering.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on dark/popular restaurant images is a thin outline placed directly over busy imagery, so its contrast and visibility may be weak.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scrim or solid circular backdrop behind the heart icon and ensure the icon meets contrast guidance against image backgrounds.
